Replays your commits on top of another branch. Use carefully on shared branches.

```bash
git reset --soft HEAD~1   # undo commit, keep changes
git reset --hard HEAD~1   # undo commit and discard changes
```

```bash
git revert <commit>
```
Creates a new commit that undoes a previous commit (safe for shared history).

```bash
git remote -v
git remote add origin https://github.com/user/repo.git
```
A pull request (PR) proposes merging one branch into another and is used for code review on GitHub/GitLab.
A .gitignore file lists files and folders Git should not track (e.g. .env, node_modules).
Commit style like feat:, fix:, docs: helps changelogs and semantic versioning.
Version format MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (e.g. 1.4.2): breaking changes, features, fixes.
Code review is checking a teammate's changes for correctness, clarity, and security before merge.
